⚠️ Katoa Google muru:

• Ūkui Play Store + Google Play ratonga + Raraunga Anga Ratonga.
• ⛔ KA waitohua koe i roto i nga kaute Google (me taapiri ano e koe).
• Ko nga whakaahua me o taputapu ka kore e pa. muri.

Kei te tino mohio koe?

strings.mdKbSmart: • Tikina pouaka matua atamai: ka taki i te pouaka matua o naianei ki te rarangi whakakore a Google (CRL) ka whakamatau i nga puna maha kia kitea ra ano he pouaka matua whaimana, me te taapiri aunoa me te whakaara ano i nga ratonga Google. Ka rere i ia paato me te hiahia ipurangi (1-3 meneti).
strings.mdKbNet: • Pouakamatua mai i te whatunga: ka tango i te pouaka matua mai i te putunga whai mana (GitHub) ka penapena ki /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Kei te hiahia ipurangi me te 1-3 meneti. Ka whakamahia i te wa i rahua te tiki atamai, i te wa ranei i hurihia a ringatia te pouaka matua.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP tātaritanga: ka taki i nga kōwae Whakarato Kī Mamao e wātea ana, ka tirotiro i te putanga tiwhikete tiwhikete TEE, ka whakaatu i te ahua taputapu KmInstallKeybox. Kaore he whakarereketanga — he tirohanga mana o te taputapu.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine taki (panui-anake): whakaatu Widevine tohu taumata (L1/L3) mai i dumpsys, DRM (IDM) te aroaro o te konae-matua, me nga ahuatanga o te punaha. Karekau he whakarereke.
strings.mdRkpManual: • A-ringa RKP whakatika: rere sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh pukapuka. Ka whakatika i nga take whakamana ina rahua te tuku aunoa. Ka tāngia e ia oma he raina angitu/rahua.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Katoa RKP whakatika: rere sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh ki tonu. Ka hapai i nga keehi uaua ka roa ake. Ka puta he hua marama i te mutunga.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Tautuhianō GMS: ūkui i ngā ratonga Play Store me Google (GMS+GSF) ka whakaara aunoa i te taputapu. Mo te oati pakeke anake - kare rawa e pa ki o whakaahua me o konae.
strings.mdCertify: • Tiwhikete purei: ka taki i te RKP te ahua o te tiwhikete tiwhikete o te taputapu me te tautuhi ano i nga taonga whakamana ina hiahiatia. Kaore e pa ki nga raraunga kaiwhakamahi.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER whakatika: whakatika Google anga ratonga (SOTER) nga take e pa ana ki te whakamana taputapu. Ka whakamahia mo etahi taputapu e whakawhirinaki ana ki te SOTER hei utu mo Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Tonoa PIF: rere sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh kaha. Ka hoatu i te tapumati i kowhiria (a-rohe/taahiraa) ka whakahou i nga konae pif.prop/pif.json. Ka puta he hua marama ki te raarangi.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF taki: e whakaatu ana i te ahua o te miihini kua whakauruhia, nga konae tapumati (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), me nga raarangi. Takina anake — kare he whakarereke.
strings.mdCanary: • Whakahoutanga Canary: rere sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Tikina te putanga hou o Canary Engine kia pai ai te hototahi ki nga tiwhikete RKP (Pepuere 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Te tātaritanga o te miihini: ka tirohia te ahua TrickyStoreOSS (pid, nga raarangi), nga konae pouaka matua (hohe me te kaiwhakamahi), te taputapu maihao pono me te tinihanga, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP. Whakaaturanga tātaritanga anake.
strings.hintKbSlots: Ka whakahaerehia e te kōwae nga mokamoka pouaka matua e rua: te tuatahi (tapu, kaua rawa e murua) me te tuarua (puurua). Ko tenei ripa e whakaatu ana ko tehea mokamoka e kaha ana, ka huri i te manakohanga, ka whakatairanga ranei i te tuarua ki te tuatahi i runga i te tono marama - me nga taapiri me te raarangi katoa.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Te tātaritanga tika: ka tirohia te kawemai matua TEE, te werohanga whare pukapuka ki roto keystore2, te mana whakakore (CRL), te kapinga rarangi whakamarumaru me te ahua RKP. Panui-anake — kaore e whakarereketia.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Hoatu haumaru:

• Kua hanga ano te rarangi whakamarumaru mai i ia taupānga kua whakauruhia.
• Kua tukuna ano te paparanga hototahi ROM ritenga.
• Kua tukuna ano te pouaka matua hohe.
• Google Play#00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000 kare rawa e pa.

Haere tonu?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Nga mokamoka pouaka matua: whakaatu i te ahua o nga mokamoka tuatahi me te tuarua ka huri i te manakohanga i waenga i a raatau. Ko te tuatahi (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) ka parea i nga wa katoa, kaua rawa e muru. Ko te whakatairanga i te tuarua ki te tuatahi me tino whakau.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Whakanuia te mokamoka tuarua ki te tuatahi:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml ka noho hei ihirangi mokamoka tuatahi.
• Ka tiakina te tuatahi o naianei hei taapiri i mua i te whakakapi.
• Kaore he mea ka mukua — ka taea te mahi.

Haere tonu?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Ūkuia te mokamoka tuarua:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml ka tangohia.
• Kaore te mokamoka tuatahi e pa.

Haere tonu?
